how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.title: Create an account
how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.subTitle: You’ll need a class code from your child’s teacher to set up your child’s account.

how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.title: Learn with your child
how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.subTitle: Your child’s teacher will send you videos to watch and activites to do together.

how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.title: Share with your teacher
how_does_it_work_data_parents_page.subTitle: Send comments and photos to your child’s teacher through the platform.

how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.title: Set a topic for your class
how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.subTitle: Schedule curriculum-aligned topics from Early Years to Year 6. Families receive a child-led video and related hands-on activities. Parents are notified when a new topic is ready for them to explore at home.

how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.title: Families learn together
how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.subTitle: Parents and children watch the video and complete the activities offline. Activities are open-ended and accessible for everyone. Families then share comments and photos to let you know how it went.

how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.title: See their engagement
how_does_it_work_data_teachers_page.subTitle: Keep track of engagement through the register view and families' comments and photos. Pupils are rewarded for their engagement with items to dress-up their Monkey Mathscot and through our termly initiatives.

what_makes_us_different_data.title: Child-led
what_makes_us_different_data.subTitle: Our friendly child-led videos support parents and children to use the methods learnt at school.

what_makes_us_different_data.title: Offline
what_makes_us_different_data.subTitle: Our games can be enjoyed using objects from around children's homes. The play-based activities are hands-on and open-ended.

what_makes_us_different_data.title: Inclusive
what_makes_us_different_data.subTitle: Our platform works on all devices - from mobile to laptop. We are working with The Developer Society to ensure that our resources are accessible to everyone.

FAQs.question: How do I find out my class code?
FAQs.answer: If you are a returning parent, it is even easier to assign your child to a class. Log in and click on your child's Mathscot. You will be given a list of the new classes. Click on their class name, then they will be added and ready to receive any new topics set.

iFeelSaidCarouselTitles:
[1] 
 “I can’t believe it!” said Greta in a disappointed voice.

[2] 
 “Look out for the shark!” said Mason, sounding scared.

[3] 
 “It hurts,” said Luca as he clutched his broken leg.

[4] 
 ““It’s so tiny,” she said quietly, “I think it must have been born today.”

[5] 
 “That planet is pretty enormous,” he said in amazement.

[6] 
 “The jewels are mine, all mine!” said the Queen with a wicked look on her face.

[7] 
 Slowly he turned around, and when he saw the dragon he said, “I’m not scared.”

[8] 
 As the tiger leaped towards them, he said, “Run!”

[9] 
 She peeped through bushes at ghosts swirling in the mist and said, “Do you think we should turn back?”

[10]
 The dark knight stood over the wolf with his sword drawn and said, “What will you do now?”

[11]
 “I will just slide this gold into my pocket,” said the gnome sneakily, “and then I will put it somewhere safe.”

[12]
 The waves broke over the sinking stern of the ship as the captain said, “My boat and I will go down together.”

would_you_rather_carousel_item: ...be able to breathe under water or breathe in space?
...have the ability to see 10 minutes into the future or 150 years into the future?
...go into the past and meet your ancestors or go into the future and meet your great-great grandchildren?
...lose the ability to read or lose the ability to speak?
...be covered in fur or covered in scales?
...know the history of every object you touched or be able to talk to animals?
...give up all drinks except for water or give up eating anything that was cooked in an oven?
...have unlimited international first-class tickets or never have to pay for food at restaurants?
...eat chocolate for every meal or never eat chocolate again?
...be able to breathe under water or breathe in space?
...be forced to dance every time you heard music or be forced to sing along to any song you heard?
...have whatever you are thinking to appear above your head for everyone to see or have absolutely everything you do live streamed for anyone to see?
